data.title: Bitmine's Tom Lee Sees $6,000 Ethereum By Year-End If Bitcoin Hits $150,000
data.description: Ethereum (ETH) could trade near $6,000 by the end of 2026, with the prediction tied to a recovery in the asset’s exchange rate against Bitcoin (BTC), said Tom Lee, co-founder of Fundstrat and chairman of Bitmine Immersion Technologies (BMNR).The Ethereum-to-Bitcoin ratio was hovering around 0.03 an…
